page.title: The best robot vacuums of 2026, tested
page.html:
Home Deals

The best robot vacuums of 2026

We buy every robot vacuum we test at retail and run the same lab tests on each: hair pickup on carpet and hard floors, noise at full power, and battery life from full to dock.

How they compare

ModelCarpet pickupHard-floor pickupNoiseBattery
Brisk R792%95%64 dB180 min
Fen Clean 391%93%61 dB170 min
Orla S2086%86%66 dB200 min
Nimbo Swift70%82%63 dB120 min

Best overall: Brisk R7

The Brisk R7 (sold as the R7-C in Canada) picked up 92% of the embedded hair on our low-pile carpet, the best result this year. Its rubber brushroll never tangled in our long-hair test.

Skip it if you have deep shag rugs: it stalled on them twice.

Quietest: Fen Clean 3

The Fen Clean 3 measured 61 dB at full power, quieter than a normal conversation.

Longest battery: Orla S20

The Orla S20 ran for 200 minutes before it docked, and its mop pad lifts on carpet.

Budget pick: Nimbo Swift

The Nimbo Swift costs far less and still cleans hard floors well.

page.title: The robot vacuums I'd buy after testing them at home
page.html:
The robot vacuums I'd buy after testing them at home

I ran each robot vacuum in my own house for three weeks, on carpet, tile and a dog's worth of hair.

Orla S20

The Orla S20 mops and vacuums in one pass, and the mop lifts itself when it reaches the rug.

Who should skip it: anyone with lots of dark floors, since its camera struggles in dim rooms.

Brisk R5

The Brisk R5 has no mop, but its brushroll shrugged off my dog's hair.
